- **Old chats work again after the rebrand**: chats saved by the pre-rebrand version (stored under the app folder root, e.g. `corvus/agent`) are now migrated into the chats folder automatically, and legacy `axxa:` markers in chat files are read again — timestamps, reactions and agent steps survive.
- **The Extensions settings tab is gone**: it only contained the Instagram Reels transcription toggle, and that feature has been removed together with it.
- **Instagram Reels support removed**: the `fetch_reel_transcript` agent tool, the auto-transcription on paste/send, and all related code and settings are gone.
